item.title: Angler arrested after getting caught cheating during North Texas fishing tournament
item.description: Tournament organizers noticed something fishy about a bass submitted to a North Texas fishing tournament Sunday, leading to a contestant's arrest for violating fishing tournament law.Something fishy at local tournamentDuring the Lake Fork Lure Company Tournament on March 8, Texas Game Wardens were contacted by organizers to investigate a bass fish presented by Curtis Lee Daniels.Tournament organizers flagged the bass during a weigh-in after a metal detector found foreign objects inside the fish.
